attributes.name: identifier
attributes.description: DB instance identifier, unique per region.

attributes.name: engine_version
attributes.description: Engine version, e.g. 16.3. Leave blank to take the current default for the engine.

attributes.name: instance_class
attributes.description: Instance size. Promoted to a variable so it can differ per environment.

attributes.name: storage_encrypted
attributes.description: Encrypt storage at rest. On by default; turning it off after creation requires a rebuild.

attributes.name: multi_az
attributes.description: Run a standby in a second availability zone. Roughly doubles cost.

attributes.name: backup_retention_period
attributes.description: Days of automated backups. Zero disables them entirely.

attributes.name: skip_final_snapshot
attributes.description: Skip the snapshot taken on delete. Left off so a destroy is recoverable.

attributes.name: publicly_accessible
attributes.description: Give the instance a public endpoint. Off by default.
